search_parameters.q: What is the price of 22 carat gold per 10 grams in Mumbai today?

response.markdown:
The price of 22 carat gold in Mumbai today (October 10, 2026) is **₹1,38,800 per 10 grams** (₹13,880 per gram), up ₹650 from yesterday. This rate is exclusive of making charges and GST.
